title: "The Bond Films"
---

::: {#ee4ffb50 .cell execution_count=1}
``` {.python .cell-code}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")
bond = films[films["franchise"] == "James Bond"]
```
:::


The dataset includes the James Bond films released between 1995 and 2021. @fig-bond shows how their worldwide revenue changed over time.

::: {#cell-fig-bond .cell execution_count=2}
``` {.python .cell-code}
plt.plot(bond["year"], bond["revenue_musd"], marker="o")
plt.xlabel("Year")
plt.ylabel("Revenue (million USD)")
plt.show()
```
